==Description==
'''Mori''' will be an entity that you will easily find in the [[Unnamed Sector]], rarely after 500, and anytime in [[Super Epic Mode]].

==Mechanics==
When '''Mori''' spawns, it will flicker the lights before rushing to the door from voidwall at moderate speed, despawning right after hitting it, he will speed up the further u go.

here are more things he can do:

* he will have a chance to spawn without flickering the lights past door 50

* he will have a chance to attack from the front once you are past 100

* he has a chance of becoming a rebounder, rushing to the door, falling back, then rush back to the main room past door ???

==Strategies==
* Just hide when you hear his ambience.

==Trivia==
Mori can invade outside the unnamed sector when you are past door 500
